info.title: ProtoWiki application API
info.description: Same-origin API contract between the browser application and Flask. Polis and Particiapi remain behind Flask.

get.summary: Return the current browser session and its site-wide capabilities
Return participant-facing conversation groups for one space
Return the participant-safe record for one conversation

403.description: The current browser cannot access this conversation

get.summary: Return the participant's identity-reveal timeline and capability

409.description: Conversation is not closed or participant has not joined

post.summary: Permanently link the participant's Wikimedia username and pseudonym
post.description: Irreversible and idempotent. A replay returns the existing public link with HTTP 200.

get.summary: Return available pseudonym suggestions for a join form

post.summary: Join a conversation with a globally unique pseudonym
post.description: Idempotent for an already joined participant; a replay returns the existing participation with HTTP 200.

200.description: Existing participation returned for an idempotent replay

get.summary: Return the current participant Explore queue state

403.description: Conversation access denied or participant banned

409.description: Participation or Explore phase is not active

get.summary: Return the participant's argument-mapping task state
get.description: Contribution status, stable argument ordering, prioritization gates, and capabilities are computed server-side. Aggregate importance counts are withheld during the open phase to avoid anchoring.

403.description: Conversation access is denied or the participant is banned

409.description: Participation is missing or argument mapping is not open

post.summary: Submit one argument for a featured-statement side
post.description: Idempotent for an identical replay. One contribution per participant, featured statement, and side is enforced by the database.

404.description: Conversation or featured statement not found

409.description: Phase conflict or a different argument already exists

put.description: Idempotent state replacement; repeated PUT requests keep the side skipped.

404.description: Conversation or featured statement not found

409.description: Phase conflict or the side already has an argument

put.summary: Set whether an argument is one of the participant's priorities
put.description: Idempotent state replacement serialized per participant, featured statement, and side.

409.description: Contribution gate, volume gate, budget, or phase conflict

post.summary: Flag a statement or argument for moderator review
post.description: Idempotent for the same participant, target, and category while a flag remains open. Other requires an explanation.

400.description: Invalid target, category, or missing Other explanation

put.summary: Set the participant's vote on an Explore statement
put.description: Idempotent: repeated PUT requests replace the vote with the requested choice.

403.description: Conversation access denied or participant banned

409.description: Participation or Explore phase is not active

post.summary: Submit a new or derivative statement during Explore
post.description: A durable idempotency receipt prevents duplicate upstream statements. Reusing a completed key with the same body returns HTTP 200; a pending receipt reports an unknown outcome.

400.description: Invalid request, idempotency key, or parent statement

403.description: Conversation access denied or participant banned

409.description: Quota, derivative similarity, idempotency conflict, or unknown outcome

502.description: The upstream command outcome is unknown

passReason.description: Optional local reason for a pass vote. Valid only when choice is pass.
